overview: Adds skip segments for intros, recaps, credits, and previews from TheIntroDB's API, with introdb.app selectable as the data source.

versions.changelog:
## What's New

### :tada: New features

* feat: add introdb.app as an alternative data source, switchable from the plugin settings page
* feat: fall back to the other source automatically when the selected one has no data or cannot address an item (introdb.app needs an IMDb id)
* feat: non-default episode orders (DVD, alternate, absolute, ...) stay resolved through TheIntroDB when introdb.app is selected, so series never get another episode's segments

The not-found cache is now keyed by the lookup plan, so switching sources re-checks items whose previous miss was recorded against the other one.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/xiaobili/theintrodb-jellyfin/commits/main
